Image 1 is the approved design sheet of the HeatYeti robe, shown in four views. Make ONE single photorealistic studio product photo, vertical 9:16, of EXACTLY this robe — same fur, same hood, same horns, same face, same ears, same mitten cuffs, same Yeti-feet foot pockets, same belt, same pockets, same proportions. Invisible ghost mannequin, light cool-grey seamless studio background, soft even studio light, the whole robe visible from the top of the hood to the floor, centered, never cropped. No text, no logos, no watermark.

VIEW: FRONT, hood UP on the head, robe closed with the belt tied. The Yeti face on the hood looks straight at the camera; both Yeti-feet foot pockets with their grey toe pads visible at the bottom.

THE ROBE, identical to the reference images in every frame — the HeatYeti "Full Shaggy Yeti" robe: the whole outside of the robe is long-pile shaggy SNOW-WHITE faux fur like a real Yeti pelt, strands with a faint icy-blue sheen at the tips; floor-length, normal-width sleeves, a soft shaggy white belt. The sleeves end in big YETI-MITTEN cuffs: shaggy white fur with a smooth slate-grey plush palm patch on the inner wrist side. The two joined foot pockets at the hem are shaped like GIANT YETI FEET, each with three rounded slate-grey toe pads on the front. The interior lining is smooth icy-blue minky, never white, never green.

THE HOOD — ABSOLUTE RULE, SAME IN EVERY FRAME: a big shaggy white Yeti head. Two curved slate-grey horns on top, one above each temple. Small rounded white ears with pale-blue inner ears on the sides. On the front above the opening, a soft 3D Yeti face: pale icy-blue skin, two narrow grumpy eyes, heavy white fur eyebrows frowning, a small dark nose, two tiny white fangs. The face exists ONLY on the hood.

THE POCKETS — ABSOLUTE RULE: the two front patch pockets are plain shaggy white fur, nothing on them — no face, no eyes, no graphic, no logo.

No red, no green, no gold, no pink, no snowflakes, no Santa print. The fur looks noticeably thick, cozy and premium — dense heavy pile, deep soft folds, weighty slow settle. The robe is visible full length, down to the floor, never cropped.
